plan.claim_under_test: For every connected bandwidth-two alternating generator graph, delta=n-rank(Omega)/2-Rstar<=1
plan.status_before: UNPROVED working conjecture; no novelty claim
plan.stage_A: All connected labeled bandwidth-two graphs of n=1..6 in increasing n and increasing edge-bit code; reuse prior reachable() implementation and exact group definitions
plan.stage_A_stop: Stop primary search at first exact counterexample, preserving all preceding cases and the counterexample
plan.stage_B_if_no_counterexample: Only two preselected graphs: three and four triangles joined successively at articulation vertices, n=7,9. No additional families or sizes
plan.positive_controls: Bipartite graphs have Rstar=n-a by measuring all of one part then all of the other; compare witnesses exactly
plan.negative_control: K5 is outside bandwidth-two family and has Rstar=1,a=2,delta=2. This disproves any unrestricted connected-graph version
plan.independent_counterexample_check: If a primary counterexample occurs, realize the same alternating form with independent canonical Pauli generators, and exhaust all reachable spaces using the physical symplectic implementation; do not claim the canonical embedding is the original geometric model
plan.statistics: Exact deterministic enumeration only; no fitted parameters, p-values, production trajectories or QPU
plan.report_standard: If no counterexample, say verified only in this finite set, not proved generally; do not require a PRL-level result but do not disguise known graph algebra as original physics
plan.preserve: Prior results, frozen plans, old code and all historical data remain read-only
